The '''DH107''' was a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] developed by [[Herzfall Corporation/Legends|Herzfall Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ISB" /> They were also fitted as internal comlinks in [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]]. The DH107 employed linked encoding sequences, giving the comlink the ability to change communications frequencies every few [[Standard second|seconds]] and keep the entire unit synchronized at the same time. The coding sequences were automatically deleted if the helmet was removed without pressing the control stud of the comlink first.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> 

After operational problems were discovered with [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[DH77 headcomm/Legends|DH77 headcomm]]&mdash;namely that explosions could create dead zones in which DH77 transmissions were lost, and contrails from [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] knocked out DH77's with a range of three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]&mdash;Herzfall Corporation developed a comlink that was less susceptible to interference and signal interception. All [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] raised after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] were outfitted with the DH107.<ref name="ISB" />
